answer: What keeps this honest is appealable verdict with bond on the challenger, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. A farm running 429 aliases would need 429 separate proofs, each costing about 104 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the vault up to the light, weigh the echo of the attack, and keep the thread of the verdict where everyone can audit it. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
